404.title: Page Not Found
404.detail: We're sorry. The page you are looking for is not available.
404.explanation: Usually this means we couldn't find the page you were looking for. Check your URL to make sure you have the correct path. Try your request again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

error.invalid_passcode: Invalid user name/Password/passcode or user account is locked or expired
error.invalid_token: The request code is invalid. It may have already been used or has expired. Return to the site or application that sent you here and try again.

login.passwordExpireContent: Your password will expire in {{expiredDay}} days. Please change your password at your earliest opportunity to prevent any interruption.
login.policyWarningContent: Your password is not compliant with current password policy. Please change your password at your earliest opportunity to prevent any interruption.
login.mfaWarningContent: The administrator has updated the MFA configuration. You need to reconfigure the MFA binding.

logout.title: Sign Out
logout.footer: If you believe you have reached this page because of an error please contact your administrator.

forgetPassword.title: Forget password
forgetPassword.tip: Enter your registered email, and we’ll send you a verification code to reset your password.
forgetPassword.sent: The reset password link has sent to your mailbox.
forgetPassword.sentCode: The code has been sent to your mailbox.
forgetPassword.return: Click here go to login page.

error.newPasswordNotRight: New passwords you entered did not match.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many requests: cannot generate code again in 1 minute.

forgetPasswordCode.tip: A verification code has been sent to your mailbox. Please check your email.

errors.session_exceeded: Concurrent session exceeds the maximum allowed!
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable at this time. Please try again later.

error.title: Oh no! Something went wrong...
error.detail: There was an error when trying to connect to the server.
error.explanation: Usually this means that an unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Check your URL to make sure you have the correct path. Try your request again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

invalidToken.title: Invalid Token
invalidToken.detail: The request code is invalid. It may have already been used or has expired.
invalidToken.detail_saml: The SAML response is invalid. Check more details with your administrator.
invalidToken.explanation: Usually this means that there was a problem with your request token. Go back to the site or application that sent you here and try again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

invalidTenant.title: Invalid Tenant
invalidTenant.detail: The specific tenant does not exist or is unavailable.
invalidTenant.explanation: Usually this means that an unexpected error occurred logging you in. Check that you are entering your credentials correctly and that you are attempting to access the correct organization. Try your request again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

mfa.title: Secure your account with MFA
mfa.tip: Scan the QR code with a TOTP compatible authenticator app, such as NetIQ. After binding to the authenticator app, click “Next”.

error.timeout: The QR code has timed out. Please click the QR code to refresh it.

totp.title: Verify code
totp.tip: Open your TOTP compatible authenticator app (such as NetIQ) to view your verification code.

user.emptySecret: User doesn't have valid TOTP secret.

qRCode.failedGeneration: Failed to generate TOTP QR code.

serviceUnavailable.title: Service Unavailable
serviceUnavailable.detail: There was an error connecting to the service. Please try again later.
serviceUnavailable.explanation: Usually this means that the service is down for maintenance or that an unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Check your URL to make sure you have the correct path. Try your request again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

invalidCredentials.title: Bad Credentials
invalidCredentials.detail: There was a problem with your credentials.
invalidCredentials.explanation: Usually this means that an unexpected error occurred logging you in. Check that you are entering your credentials correctly. Try your request again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

invalidSamlToken.title: SAML Token Invalid.
invalidSamlToken.detail: The SAML Token returned from the identity provider is invalid, or it has expired.
invalidSamlToken.explanation: Usually this means that there was a problem with your SAML token. Go back to the site or application that sent you here and try again. If that doesn't work please contact your administrator.

dbUser.title: Sign up
dbUser.instructions: You can quickly access free trails here. No contract or credit card required!
dbUser.passwordTip: For security concerns, please set a password that wasn't used in the past and doesn't contain sensitive information, e.g. user account.

error.permissionDenied: You are not allowed to sign up.
error.IllegalEmail: Please enter a valid email address
error.GeneralError: Unknown error. Please contact your system administrator
error.DuplicateEmail: The provided email is associated with multiple accounts. Please contact your system administrator.
error.passwordUsedBefore: Password used in the last 10 versions.
error.passwordExpiredMore: Password expired. Please contact the admin to reset your password.
error.passwordLostUpperLower: Contain both upper and lower case characters
error.passwordHasUserInfo: Password contains sensitive information in user's attributes.
error.groupRepresentationNotFound: Group does not contain a database group representation.
error.userExisted: That email address is taken. Please try another.
